newsitem.title: USA: Owens-Illinois obtains consents and tenders.
newsitem.headline: Owens-Illinois obtains consents and tenders.

text.p: Owens-Illinois Inc said Monday that as of the close of business May 9, 1997, it had obtained consents and tenders from registered holders of its 11 percent Senior Debentures due 2003 representing more than 95 percent of the $1 billion aggregate principal amount of the outstanding 11 percent Senior Debentures.

The company said the consent solicitation period for the Senior Debentures has expired, and Owens-Illinois has executed the supplemental indenture reflecting the amendments to the indenture governing the Senior Debentures.
The company said the amendments eliminate the indenture's restrictive covenants and modify certain of its other provisions.
The company said that as announced previously, the tender offer will expire at midnight EST on May 22, 1997, unless extended.
Holders may tender their 11 percent Senior Debentures until such time but holders tendering after 1700 EDT on May 9 will not be entitled to receive the consent payment, the company said.

Owens-Illinois also announced that it has received the consent of the requisite number of lenders participating in its existing bank credit facility to obtain the release of the collateral securing the company's obligations under the existing credit facility and the 11 percent Senior Debentures and to obtain the release of the guarantees of the company's obligations under the existing credit facility.

The company intends to release the guarantees and collateral securing the Senior Debentures and the existing credit facility at the same time as the closing of the company's proposed common stock and senior note offerings. In addition, Owens-Illinois announced that it has received commitments from existing and potential lenders in excess of the amount required to amend the existing credit facility to increase the amount the company may borrow to $3.0 billion compared with $1.8 billion currently. These commitments are subject to a number of conditions.

Closing of the tender offer for the 11 percent Senior Debentures is subject to a number of conditions, as announced previously, including receipt of proceeds from the company's proposed common stock and senior note offerings, which, when combined with amounts available for borrowing under the credit facility, will be sufficient to pay for the Senior Debentures tendered in the tender offer, and the valid tender of and consent from holders of the outstanding Senior Debentures.

The consent solicitation and tender offer for the 11 percent Senior Debentures and the amendments to the credit facility are parts of a previously announced refinancing plan under which Owens-Illinois intends to refinance outstanding public indebtedness. The refinancing plan is designed to reduce interest expense and long term debt, extend long term debt maturities, reduce the company's debt-to-equity ratio, and improve its financial flexibility.
